audience: course creators and school admins who run their online school on LearnWorlds

useCases.title: Check enrollment and results of a course
useCases.text: The AI lists courses, reads course analytics (students, average score, success rate, study time, certificates) and the users enrolled.

useCases.title: Check how a student is doing
useCases.text: The AI finds a user by id or email, lists their courses and reads the progress in one course: status, progress rate, score and completed units.

useCases.title: Review grades and certificates of a course
useCases.text: The AI reads the assessment grades per user and learning unit, and the certificates awarded for a course.

useCases.title: Review payments and what was bought
useCases.text: The AI lists payments with product, price, discount, tax, coupon and gateway, and opens one by payment id or transaction id.

useCases.title: Read the outline of a course
useCases.text: The AI reads a course's sections and the videos, PDFs, assessments and other activities in each.

useCases.title: Add, enroll, tag or group a learner
useCases.text: The AI creates a learner account, enrolls a user in a course, bundle or subscription, tags a user, or adds a user to a group.
